title: Whole Life Insurance New Business Rules: Issue, Placement in Force and the Graded Death Benefit
content:
## 1. Issue

1.1 A tier of Whole Life Insurance is issued only within its issue ages, its smallest and largest base face amounts, and on its underwriting basis.

1.2 A policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove term policy is issued without evidence of insurability, in the underwriting class of the converted term policy, at the insured's attained age on the conversion date, and is not subject to the tier's medical underwriting.

1.3 The first installment is billed on the issue date.

## 2. Placement

2.1 A premium-paying policy is placed in force when it is delivered and the first installment is paid.

2.2 An Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life policy is placed directly in paid-up status when it is delivered and the single premium is paid. It is a modified endowment contract from issue where the tier is marked as a modified endowment contract from issue.

2.3 A declined or withdrawn application has any premium received refunded in full, without interest.

## 3. Graded death benefit on the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life

3.1 On the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life, for the tier's graded benefit period from the issue date, a death from illness pays the tier's graded benefit multiple times the premiums paid, instead of the face amount. An accidental death pays the full face amount from issue.

3.2 Premiums paid are measured from the issue date to the evaluation date: the total of the premium payments on the policy made by EFT, check, debit card, online bank payment, automatic premium loan or conversion credit, less the payments returned unpaid and less the premium refunded as overpayment.

## Cause of death and policy year (Final Expense tier, graded period of 2 policy years, graded multiple of 1.1)

| Death | Within the graded period | After the graded period |
|---|---|---|
| From illness | 1.1 times premiums paid | Face amount |
| Accidental | Face amount | Face amount |

**Worked case (hypothetical).** A Final Expense policy with a face of 10000 dollars; payments of 1450.00 by EFT and 120.00 by check, one EFT payment of 70.00 returned unpaid. Premiums paid are 1450.00 plus 120.00 less 70.00, that is 1500.00. A death from illness in the graded period pays 1.1 times 1500.00, that is 1650.00; an accidental death in the same period pays the face of 10000.00.
